rationale: Temperature exposure capped at 2 hours: the passive-shipper air lane (3 h at hand-overs) and sea-air (3.5 h total) are out; the active-container air lane (1.5 h) and ocean via RTM (2.0 h) stay. Cost-optimal stays ocean; time-optimal becomes active-container air at 30,000 USD or more, and because ocean is late most of the time the risk-adjusted plan is air.
falsifier: Refuted if the cost-optimal plan is not ocean, the time-optimal plan is not air, the time-optimal cost is below 30,000 USD, or the risk-adjusted plan is not air.
